latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides image recognition for Ali Bailian GLM users via Kimi K2.5.

- Enables automatic image analysis when requested or when model replies with “no media-understanding provider.”
- Detects and reuses existing API Keys from multiple locations; caches keys for future runs.
- Simple CLI tool for image recognition with optional custom prompts.
- Provides clear instructions for setup and troubleshooting missing API Keys.
